rule_outs: Dwelling 9 m from the best section
summary: Narrow residential cul-de-sac, very steep, with homes right beside the kerb.

drivers.seclusion: Houses ring the cul-de-sac head, 9 to 12 m away, with a pool and tennis court beside.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with no verge; a parked van would block the head.
drivers.traffic: Very quiet dead end serving a few homes.
drivers.convention: 2P Mon-Fri 7-6, residents excepted; no cars parked on the kerb in the imagery.

sun_shade: Mixed tree shade over the lane, mainly from the west.
